name: Async Tests
snippet:
The TestClient does some magic inside to call the asynchronous FastAPI application in your normal def test functions, using standard pytest .
Imagine you want to test sending requests to your FastAPI application and then verify that your backend successfully wrote the correct data in the database, while using an async database library.
